continuity: Park Jihoon's hand-to-hand movement is comparable to a Peak master's grappling technique, though Taekyung considers it somewhat clumsy.
Park Jihoon carries a separate phone for secret communications; it requires fingerprint and iris recognition.
Park Jihoon used a potion to heal the injuries Taekyung had inflicted during their confrontation.
Jihoon says 'that person' enforces choices through definite rewards and punishments, and Park Tae Seop is unwilling to oppose that person's demands.
Taekyung's Scorching Yang Qi formed a fire dragon, dispersed through hundreds of streams, and was then recombined for release.
Park Tae Seop fights with a greatsword and shield and possesses an aura powerful enough to confront Taekyung's Scorching Yang Qi.
Taekyung overpowered Park Tae Seop, split his shield, and used Mae Jonghak's Flow principle to disarm both opponents.
Taekyung shattered Park Jihoon's knee and was interrupted while preparing to destroy his remaining knee.
plot: Jin Taekyung continued assaulting Park Jihoon after overpowering him and discovered that Jihoon knew hand-to-hand combat comparable to a Peak master's grappling technique. Jihoon carried a separate phone protected by fingerprint and iris recognition, recovered from Taekyung's attack by drinking a potion, and invoked the coercive rewards and punishments associated with 'that person' to obtain Park Tae Seop's help. Taekyung released a jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi and demonstrated the overwhelming difference between their classes.

Park Tae Seop reluctantly armed himself with a greatsword and shield and joined Jihoon against Taekyung. Taekyung evaded Tae Seop's attacks, broke his shield, and used the Flow principle he had learned from Mae Jonghak to entangle and disarm both men. He shattered Jihoon's knee and was about to destroy the other one when an unidentified, impossibly deep voice interrupted the fight, leading Taekyung to wonder whether its owner was a Supreme Peak master.
translation_decisions: Render 행신동 불닭볶음손 as 'Haengsin-dong Fire-Chicken Stir-Fried Hand,' retaining the buldak-bokkeum-myeon/son pun in a footnote.
Render 흐름 as 'Flow' when naming Taekyung's application of Mae Jonghak's movement principle.

active_continuity: Taekyung confronted Park Jihoon by phone while holding the Myeongdong Guild Team 1 Leader captive.
Jihoon threatened to end Taekyung and the Peace Guild if Taekyung advanced farther.
Taekyung defeated Myeongdong Guild Team 1 and occupied Jihoon's office.
Choi Minwoo led an evidence-gathering ambush after the secret house burned and captured Myeongdong Guild personnel.
Park Tae Seop recognizes Taekyung as a threat capable of cracking Myeongdong Guild, while Jihoon remains dismissive.
Park Tae Seop is Myeongdong Guild's Guild Master, a Great Cataclysm war hero, and one of Korea's top rankers.
Jihoon says Myeongdong Guild sent the Black Hunters to suppress the Peace Guild and coordinated a blockade of high-level Gates around it.
Jihoon offers major financial and territorial concessions in exchange for the Peace Guild's prisoners and silence, while demanding that its growth remain limited.
Taekyung demands a sincere apology and compensation for the injured D-rank Hunter and his family.
Jihoon is acting under orders from an unidentified person whom he calls 'that person.'
Jihoon is secretly much stronger than the nominal Team 1 Leader and functions as his superior despite holding only an ordinary Hunter position.
Taekyung broke Jihoon's wrist and slammed his head into the table at the end of the confrontation.
Jihoon's hand-to-hand movement is comparable to a Peak master's grappling technique, though somewhat clumsy.
Jihoon carries a secret phone protected by fingerprint and iris recognition and used a potion to recover from Taekyung's assault.
'That person' uses definite rewards and punishments to compel obedience, including from Park Tae Seop.
Taekyung can disperse and recombine a jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi for a powerful release.
Park Tae Seop fights with a greatsword and shield and reluctantly joined Jihoon against Taekyung.
Taekyung broke Tae Seop's shield, applied Mae Jonghak's Flow principle, and disarmed both men.
Taekyung shattered Jihoon's knee before an unidentified deep voice interrupted the fight.

Will the unknown commander be brought to apologize, and will the proposed concessions be accepted or enforced?
Who is the unidentified voice that interrupts the fight, and is its owner connected to 'that person'?
